About us

A small, focused IT training studio.

Byte Link was started by IT practitioners who were tired of courses that stayed theoretical. Every program is built and taught by people currently working in the field it covers — developers teaching development, security analysts teaching security, cloud engineers teaching cloud.

We keep cohorts small on purpose. A course is only as good as the feedback a student gets on their work. If you want a straight answer about whether a course fits your level, reach out before you register.
